content.text: {"rows":[{"source_id":"id07431","target":"Затем, подойдя к опущенной шторке, он сказал:"},{"source_id":"id07432","target":"— Приятного вам времяпрепровождения, монсеньор! — сказал он."},{"source_id":"id07433","target":"— Болтун! — крикнул д’Артаньян. — Из-за вас меня выгонят."},{"source_id":"id07434","target":"Шлагбаум заскрипел на петлях; д’Артаньян, увидев, что путь свободен, хлестнул лошадей, и те крупной рысью понеслись вперёд."},{"source_id":"id07435","target":"Через пять минут они догнали карету кардинала."},{"source_id":"id07436","target":"— Мушкетон, — крикнул д’Артаньян, — поднимите шторки на карете Его Величества."},{"source_id":"id07437","target":"— Это он, — сказал Портос."},{"source_id":"id07438","target":"— В кучерах! — воскликнул Мазарини."},{"source_id":"id07439","target":"— Да ещё с каретой коадъютора! — сказала королева."},{"source_id":"id07440","target":"— Corpo di Dio! Монсу д’Артаньян, — сказал Мазарини, — вы стоите своего веса в золоте!"}],"review":[{"source_id":"id07431","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Faithful; the baissé mantelet rendered as the lowered shade, speaker and sequence preserved."},{"source_id":"id07432","verdict":"CORRECTED","reason":"The draft contained a Latin-script fragment 'monseigneur' inside the Russian; replaced with 'монсеньор'. The meaning is otherwise preserved, including the sergeant's ironic wish of pleasure."},{"source_id":"id07433","verdict":"PASS","reason":"'Indiscret' as 'Болтун' fits the context, with the threat of dismissal preserved; the dialogue punctuation is correct."},{"source_id":"id07434","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Gate creaking, d'Artagnan's whipping the horses and the brisk trot are all preserved."},{"source_id":"id07435","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Accurate; the impersonal 'on' is naturally rendered as 'они' for the party."},{"source_id":"id07436","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Order to Mousqueton and the reference to His Majesty's carriage are accurate."},{"source_id":"id07437","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Accurate."},{"source_id":"id07438","verdict":"PASS","reason":"'En cocher' means disguised as a coachman; 'В кучерах' conveys this idiomatically."},{"source_id":"id07439","verdict":"CORRECTED","reason":"'Et avec le carrosse du coadjuteur' means 'and with the coadjutor's carriage'; 'в карете' could suggest being inside it, so it was changed to 'с каретой'."},{"source_id":"id07440","verdict":"CORRECTED","reason":"Mazarin's Italianized 'monsou' was transliterated as 'Монсу' to mimic his accent, and the italics were kept as in the source."}]}
